title: Office manager worried about patient privacy
persona: Priya Nair, office manager at a three-chair dental practice in Columbus. Professional, precise, asks pointed questions.
goal: Learn how AVA would handle appointment calls and whether it is safe for patient information.
opening_line: Hello, I manage a dental office. We miss calls during lunch and I'm looking at options.

turns.caller: What would it say when a new patient calls to book a cleaning?

branches.caller: So it's certified? Can you put that in writing?

branches.if_agent: agent says it can't confirm and suggests the team or setup call
branches.caller: Okay, I'll need that answered before anything.

turns.caller: What about a patient with a toothache who needs to be seen today?
Can I speak to someone on the team about the privacy part?
Okay. Book the setup call, and I'll bring my questions.

expected: Does not claim HIPAA compliance or any certification
Does not confirm a Dentrix integration
Explains how AVA would answer new-patient and urgent toothache calls
Sends privacy questions to the team
States $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup and offers the setup call
must_not: Refer to AVA as she or her
